name: Ability Focus
description: +2 to the DC of one special attack you possess.

name: Acrobatic
description: +2 bonus on Jump and Tumble checks.

name: Agile
description: +2 bonus on Balance and Escape Artist checks.

name: Alertness
description: +2 bonus on Listen and Spot checks.

name: Animal Affinity
description: +2 bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks.

name: Armor Proficiency (Heavy)
description: No armor check penalty on attack rolls when wearing heavy armor.

name: Armor Proficiency (Light)
description: No armor check penalty on attack rolls when wearing light armor.

name: Armor Proficiency (Medium)
description: No armor check penalty on attack rolls when wearing medium armor.

name: Athletic
description: +2 bonus on Climb and Swim checks.

name: Augment Summoning
description: Creatures you summon with conjuration (summoning) spells gain +4 Str and +4 Con.

name: Awesome Blow
description: As a standard action, send a corporeal opponent smaller than you flying 10 feet and knock it prone.

name: Blindsight (5 ft Radius)
description: Gain blindsight out to 5 feet, allowing you to detect and fight unseen foes within that range.

name: Brew Potion
description: Create potions of spells of 3rd level or lower that target one or more creatures.

name: CATEGORY=FEAT|Improved Familiar.MOD
description: Modifier entry for Improved Familiar feat data.

name: Cleave (Granted by Sylvan Scimitar)
description: Cleave feat granted by the Sylvan Scimitar magic item.

name: Combat Casting
description: +4 bonus on Concentration checks made to cast defensively or while grappled.

name: Craft Construct
description: Create magical constructs such as golems and shield guardians.

name: Craft Magic Arms and Armor
description: Create magic weapons, armor, and shields.

name: Craft Rod
description: Create magic rods.

name: Craft Staff
description: Create magic staffs.

name: Craft Wand
description: Create wands of spells of 4th level or lower.

name: Craft Wondrous Item
description: Create miscellaneous magic items such as cloaks, boots, and amulets.

name: Deceitful
description: +2 bonus on Disguise and Forgery checks.

name: Deflect Arrows
description: Once per round, deflect one ranged attack that would normally hit you.

name: Deft Hands
description: +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand and Use Rope checks.

name: Diehard
description: Automatically become stable when reduced to negative hit points. You may act while disabled or dying.

name: Diligent
description: +2 bonus on Appraise and Decipher Script checks.

name: Disguise Spell
description: Disguise spellcasting as part of a Perform check so observers don't notice you're casting. Uses spell slot +1 level higher.

name: Divine Might
description: Spend a turn/rebuke undead attempt as a free action to add your Charisma bonus to weapon damage for 1 round.

name: Divine Vengeance
description: Spend a turn undead attempt as a free action to add 2d6 holy damage to melee attacks against undead for 1 round.

name: Empower Spell
description: Increase all variable numeric effects of a spell by 50%. Uses spell slot +2 levels higher.

name: Empower Spell-Like Ability
description: Increase all variable numeric effects of one spell-like ability by 50%. Usable twice per day.

name: Endurance
description: +4 bonus on checks and saves involving extended physical activity (swim, run, hold breath, etc.).

name: Energy Substitution
description: Substitute one energy type for another in a spell's damage. No change in spell slot level.

name: Enlarge Spell
description: Double the range of a spell. Uses spell slot +1 level higher.

name: Eschew Materials
description: Cast spells without material components costing 1 gp or less.

name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
description: No penalty on attack rolls when using the selected exotic weapon.

name: Extend Spell
description: Double the duration of a spell. Uses spell slot +1 level higher.

name: Extra Music
description: Gain four extra uses per day of bardic music.

name: Extra Turning
description: Gain four extra turn/rebuke undead attempts per day.

name: Eyes in the Back of Your Head
description: Attackers do not gain flanking bonuses against you. You still grant sneak attack from flanking.

name: Far Shot
description: Increase range increment by 50% for projectile weapons, or double it for thrown weapons.

name: Fleet of Foot
description: When running or charging, you may make a single direction change of up to 90 degrees.

name: Flyby Attack
description: When flying, take a standard action at any point during your move without provoking from the target.

name: Forge Ring
description: Create magic rings.

name: Greater Spell Focus
description: +1 to the DC of spells from the selected school (stacks with Spell Focus for +2 total).

name: Greater Spell Penetration
description: +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance (stacks with Spell Penetration for +4 total).

name: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting
description: Gain a third off-hand attack at a -10 penalty.

name: Heighten Spell
description: Cast a spell as if it were a higher-level spell. All level-dependent effects use the new, higher level.

name: Hold the Line
description: Make an attack of opportunity against a charging opponent who enters your threatened area.

name: Hover
description: Halt in midair while flying without needing to maintain forward speed. Creates a downdraft.

name: Improved Counterspell
description: Counterspell using a spell from the same school that is one or more levels higher.

name: Improved Critical
description: Double the threat range of the selected weapon.

name: Improved Disarm
description: +4 bonus on disarm attempts. No attack of opportunity when you attempt to disarm.

name: Improved Familiar
description: Gain access to more powerful familiar options based on your alignment and arcane caster level. Replaces the basic familiar choice when a valid improved option is picked.

name: Wild Cohort
description: Gain the service of a loyal animal, treated as an animal companion of a druid of your character level minus 3 (minimum 1). Approximates the Complete Adventurer feat (not yet extracted from official source).

name: Improved Feint
description: Feint in combat as a move action instead of a standard action.

name: Improved Grapple
description: +4 bonus on grapple checks. No attack of opportunity when you start a grapple.

name: Improved Natural Armor
description: +1 to natural armor bonus. May be taken multiple times; effects stack.

name: Improved Natural Attack
description: Increase the damage die of one natural weapon by one step (e.g. 1d4 to 1d6).

name: Improved Overrun
description: +4 bonus on overrun attempts. Target cannot choose to avoid you.

name: Improved Precise Shot
description: No penalty for ranged attacks against targets in melee. Ignore anything less than total cover/concealment.

name: Improved Shield Bash
description: Retain your shield's AC bonus when making a shield bash attack.

name: Improved Turning
description: +1 to your effective cleric level when turning or rebuking undead.

name: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting
description: Gain a second off-hand attack at a -5 penalty.

name: Improved Unarmed Strike
description: Deal lethal damage with unarmed strikes and do not provoke attacks of opportunity when attacking unarmed.

name: Investigator
description: +2 bonus on Gather Information and Search checks.

name: Jack Of All Trades
description: Use any skill untrained, even skills that normally require training.

name: Knock Down
description: When you deal 10+ damage in melee, make a free trip attempt that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Leadership
description: Attract a cohort and followers based on your Leadership score.

name: Magical Aptitude
description: +2 bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks.

name: Manyshot
description: Fire two or more arrows simultaneously as a standard action at a single target within 30 feet.

name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
description: No penalty on attack rolls when using the selected martial weapon.

name: Maximize Spell
description: All variable numeric effects of a spell are maximized. Uses spell slot +3 levels higher.

name: Mounted Archery
description: Halve the penalty for ranged attacks while mounted.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Once per round, negate a hit on your mount with a Ride check.

name: Multiattack
description: Secondary natural weapon attacks take only a -2 penalty instead of -5.

name: Multiweapon Fighting
description: Reduce penalties for fighting with multiple weapons (for creatures with three or more hands).

name: Natural Spell
description: Cast spells while in wild shape form, using the form's natural abilities for somatic components.

name: Negotiator
description: +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

name: Nimble Fingers
description: +2 bonus on Disable Device and Open Lock checks.

name: Persistent Spell
description: A fixed-range or personal spell lasts 24 hours. Uses spell slot +6 levels higher.

name: Persuasive
description: +2 bonus on Bluff and Intimidate checks.

name: Plant Control
description: Rebuke or command plant creatures as an evil cleric rebukes undead.

name: Plant Defiance
description: Turn or destroy plant creatures as a good cleric turns undead.

name: Point Blank Shot
description: +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons at targets within 30 feet.

name: Power Critical
description: +4 bonus on the roll to confirm a critical threat with the selected weapon.

name: Precise Shot
description: No -4 penalty for shooting into melee.

name: Quick Draw
description: Draw a weapon as a free action instead of a move action.

name: Quicken Spell
description: Cast a spell as a free action. Uses spell slot +4 levels higher.

name: Quicken Spell-Like Ability
description: Use one spell-like ability as a free action up to three times per day.

name: Rapid Reload
description: Reload the selected crossbow type faster: heavy as a move action, light as a free action.

name: Rapid Shot
description: Get one extra ranged attack per round at your highest bonus, but all attacks take -2.

name: Reach Spell
description: Cast a touch spell as a ranged touch attack with 30-foot range. Uses spell slot +2 levels higher.

name: Repeat Spell
description: A repeated spell is automatically cast again on the next round. Uses spell slot +3 levels higher.

name: Ride-By Attack
description: Move before and after a mounted charge attack, as long as total distance doesn't exceed your mount's speed.

name: Run
description: Run at 5x normal speed (or 4x in heavy armor). Retain Dex bonus to AC while running.

name: Sacred Spell
description: Half of the spell's damage becomes divine (sacred) energy not subject to energy resistance. Uses spell slot +2 levels higher.

name: Scribe Scroll
description: Create scrolls of any spell you know.

name: Self-Sufficient
description: +2 bonus on Heal and Survival checks.

name: Sharp Shooting
description: Halve the AC bonus granted by cover for ranged attacks you make.

name: Shield Proficiency
description: No armor check penalty on attack rolls when using a shield.

name: Shot on the Run
description: Move before and after making a ranged attack, as long as total distance doesn't exceed your speed.

name: Silent Spell
description: Cast a spell without verbal components. Uses spell slot +1 level higher.

name: Simple Weapon Proficiency
description: No penalty on attack rolls when using simple weapons.

name: Skill Focus
description: +3 bonus on checks with the selected skill.

name: Snatch
description: Grapple a smaller creature with a claw or bite attack, automatically dealing damage each round.

name: Snatch Arrows
description: Catch ranged weapons instead of just deflecting them. May throw back a weapon as a free action.

name: Spell Focus
description: +1 to the DC of saving throws against spells from the selected school.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Prepare a number of spells equal to your Int modifier without a spellbook (wizard only).

name: Spell Penetration
description: +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Spirited Charge
description: Deal double damage on a mounted charge (triple with a lance).

name: Stealthy
description: +2 bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.

name: Still Spell
description: Cast a spell without somatic components. Uses spell slot +1 level higher.

name: Stunning Fist
description: Declare before attack; if you hit, target must save (DC 10 + 1/2 level + Wis mod) or be stunned for 1 round.

name: Subdual Substitution
description: Change an energy spell's damage to nonlethal damage. No change in spell slot level.

name: Superior Expertise
description: Trade attack bonus for AC bonus on a 1-for-1 basis with no limit from BAB (improved Combat Expertise).

name: Tower Shield Proficiency
description: No penalty on attack rolls when using a tower shield.

name: Track
description: Use the Survival skill to find and follow tracks.

name: Trample
description: When mounted and charging, your mount may make a hoof attack against the target as a free action.

name: Two-Weapon Defense
description: +1 shield bonus to AC when wielding a weapon in each hand.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: Reduce two-weapon fighting penalties: -2 primary / -2 off-hand (with light off-hand weapon).

name: Weapon Finesse
description: Use Dex modifier instead of Str on attack rolls with light melee weapons.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: As a full-round action, make one melee attack against each opponent within reach.

name: Widen Spell
description: Double the area of a burst, emanation, line, or spread spell. Uses a spell slot three levels higher.

name: Wingover
description: A flying creature can make a turn of up to 180 degrees as a free action, regardless of maneuverability.
